name: Netlify
how_to_set: Use a credit-based plan; Team settings > Billing: keep Auto recharge OFF (it is off by default).
When credits run out, projects pause until the next cycle; that is the hard cap.
Set usage notifications in the billing page.
kill_switch: Out of credits: all team projects pause (traffic, forms and deploys blocked) until the next cycle or a top-up.
traps: Auto recharge turns the cap into a pay-as-you-go bill
Pausing takes the whole team offline, not one project
unverified: Current auto-recharge credit pack prices differ between Netlify pages
